currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann die in der Einführungsphase erarbeiteten Inhalte zu Funktionen und Darstellungen, Ableitungsbegriff und Anwendungen, ganzrationalen Funktionen, Exponentialfunktionen, trigonometrischen Funktionen und Ableitungsregeln in Q1-Anschlussaufgaben passend auswählen, begründet einsetzen und fachlich einordnen.

blockingFindings: The main blue maximum projects between the labeled x=2 and x=4 ticks, not to x=2. h'=e^(−x)x(2−x) forces the positive interior maximum to x=2.
A newly drawn green line at the origin slopes upward rather than horizontally. h'(0)=0 requires a horizontal tangent. The correct derivative text does not cure this contradictory visible mark.
positiveControls: The product/chain derivative and x=0 or x=2 algebra remain correct.
The positive hump and right-hand tail remain recognizable; no new positive zero is introduced.
h(x)=x²e^(−x), x≥0, is consistent across the title strip, graph and derivation.

The graph starts at (0,0) with the visible horizontal green tangent, rises initially convex, has its maximum precisely over x=2 at 4/e²≈0.541341 and stays positive while approaching zero to the right.
Both green tangent segments are horizontal. The maximum point, dashed projections, y-ticks 0.2,0.4,0.6 and x-ticks 0,2,4,6,8 agree with the sampled curve.
h'=2xe^(−x)+x²(−e^(−x))=e^(−x)x(2−x) is correct. The factor −1 is correctly attributed to the inner function −x.
Since e^(−x)>0, the sign arguments h'>0 on (0,2) and h'<0 on (2,∞) correctly justify rise and fall. h'(0)=h'(2)=0 is correct; x=0 is explicitly a boundary and h(2)=4/e² the maximum.

The example connects representations, product/chain rule selection and qualitative reasoning, appropriately illustrating the current broad Q1 transfer competence without claiming to cover every function family.
All displayed formulas, explanations, process arrows, axis labels and point annotations are legible in the actual 1600x900 PNG; no content was visibly clipped or obscured.
negativeControls: No oblique origin tangent, wrong maximum abscissa, extra positive zero, algebraic sign error or prematurely vanishing right tail remains.
A single worked example is not claimed to prove learner mastery or to exhaust all competencies listed by the goal.
The native exception is specific to two demonstrated targeted Nano repair failures, not a general replacement of Nano Banana as the first-choice generation provider.
